tools.name: get_company_health
tools.description: Get a company's overall financial health score (A-F grade) including summary metrics

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Get financial trends over time for a company — revenue, profit, margins across reporting periods

tools.name: industry_comparison
tools.description: Compare a company's financial metrics against its industry averages

tools.name: get_revenue_segments
tools.description: Get revenue breakdown by product/service segments for a company

tools.name: get_income_statement
tools.description: Get detailed income statement for a company (revenue, expenses, earnings per share)

tools.name: get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get detailed balance sheet for a company (assets, liabilities, equity)

tools.name: get_cash_flow
tools.description: Get detailed cash flow statement for a company (operating, investing, financing)

tools.name: get_all_financial_data
tools.description: Get all financial data (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) in one call

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get company profile — sector, industry, employees, description, market cap

tools.name: get_filing_types
tools.description: Get filing types available for a company (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.)

tools.name: search_filings
tools.description: Search filings for a company — search by form type, date range, keywords. Use get_filing_types first to see what's available.

tools.name: get_insider_trades
tools.description: Get recent insider trading activity for a company (Form 4 filings)

tools.name: get_sentiment
tools.description: Get sentiment analysis from SEC filings for a company — positive/negative/neutral signals from 10-K/10-Q reports

tools.name: compare_companies
tools.description: Compare financial metrics across multiple companies side by side

tools.name: screen_companies
tools.description: Screen companies by financial criteria (high growth, low debt, profitable, high margin, cash rich, undervalued)

tools.name: batch_query
tools.description: Batch query multiple tickers at once for efficiency

tools.name: fx_get_rates
tools.description: Get live exchange rates for any currency. Sources: European Central Bank + 84 central banks, 201 currencies. No API key needed — free for commercial use.

tools.name: fx_get_pair_rate
tools.description: Get the exchange rate between any two currencies. Sources: ECB + 84 central banks. Free for commercial use.

tools.name: fx_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another at current exchange rates. Sources: ECB + 84 central banks. Free for commercial use.

tools.name: fx_list_currencies
tools.description: List all 31 available currency codes and names for foreign exchange queries. Covers USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, and more.

tools.name: get_gdp
tools.description: Get latest US GDP data from FRED

tools.name: search_scholarly
tools.description: Search scholarly research works (OpenAlex, keyless) — titles, authors, year, citation counts

tools.name: get_labor_series
tools.description: Get BLS labor market series (keyless) — unemployment rate default (LNS14000000)

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Get air quality data (OpenAQ) — PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2 for a city

tools.name: get_bea_gdp
tools.description: Get US GDP from BEA (NIPA accounts)

tools.name: get_inflation
tools.description: Get latest CPI/inflation data from FRED

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Get latest Fed funds rate, mortgage rates, and treasury yields from FRED

tools.name: get_employment
tools.description: Get latest unemployment rate and jobless claims from FRED

tools.name: get_housing
tools.description: Get latest housing starts and existing home sales data from FRED

tools.name: get_econ_summary
tools.description: Get all key economic indicators (GDP, CPI, rates, employment, housing) in one call from FRED

tools.name: get_zip_demographics
tools.description: Get demographics for a ZIP code (population, income, age, housing, education) from the US Census Bureau

tools.name: get_county_demographics
tools.description: Get county-level demographics data by FIPS code from the US Census Bureau

tools.name: treasury_debt
tools.description: Get US federal debt to the penny — total public debt outstanding, debt held by the public, intragovernmental holdings. Source: US Treasury Fiscal Data (free, unrestricted, commercial use allowed).

tools.name: treasury_fx_rates
tools.description: Get official US Treasury reporting rates of exchange — daily official FX rates for 100+ currencies. Source: US Treasury Fiscal Data (free, unrestricted).

tools.name: treasury_interest_rates
tools.description: Get US Treasury average interest rates by security type (T-bills, notes, bonds). Source: US Treasury Fiscal Data (free, unrestricted).

tools.name: eurostat_gdp
tools.description: Get Eurostat GDP (annual, million EUR, current prices) for an EU country or aggregate (DE, FR, IT, EU27_2020, EA20). Source: Eurostat dissemination API (free of charge, commercial use with attribution).

tools.name: eurostat_inflation
tools.description: Get Eurostat HICP inflation — annual rate of change (%) for an EU country (DE, FR, IT, EU27_2020, EA20). Source: Eurostat dissemination API.

tools.name: eurostat_unemployment
tools.description: Get Eurostat unemployment rate (%) — monthly, seasonally adjusted, age 15-74, for an EU country (DE, FR, IT, EU27_2020, EA20). Source: Eurostat dissemination API.

tools.name: oecd_leading_indicators
tools.description: Get OECD Composite Leading Indicators (CLI, amplitude-adjusted) for an OECD country (USA, DEU, JPN, GBR, etc.). Source: OECD Data Explorer (openly reusable with attribution, no key).

tools.name: nws_forecast
tools.description: Get official NWS weather forecast (7-day periods: temperature, wind, short/detailed forecast) for a latitude/longitude. Source: NOAA National Weather Service (free for any purpose).

tools.name: nws_alerts
tools.description: Get active NWS weather alerts (watches, warnings, advisories) for a US state (e.g. FL, CA, TX). Source: NOAA National Weather Service (free for any purpose).

tools.name: fda_drug_labels
tools.description: Search FDA drug labels by brand/generic name or ingredient. Source: openFDA (public-domain US FDA data). Disclaimer: not validated for clinical/production use.

tools.name: fda_recalls
tools.description: Get recent FDA drug enforcement recalls (product, reason, classification, status, company). Source: openFDA (public-domain US FDA data).

tools.name: datausa_population
tools.description: Get US population by geography (Nation/State/County/Place) from Data USA API (curated Census ACS data). No key required.

tools.name: datausa_income
tools.description: Get US median household income by geography (Nation/State/County/Place) from Data USA API (curated Census ACS data). No key required.

tools.name: usgs_earthquakes
tools.description: Get recent earthquakes worldwide with magnitude, location, depth, and tsunami flag. Source: USGS FDSN Event Web Service (public-domain, unlimited, no key).

tools.name: usaspending_budget
tools.description: Get total US federal budgetary resources (spending authority) by fiscal year and period. Source: USAspending.gov API (US government open data, no key).

tools.name: usaspending_awards
tools.description: Search US federal contract/grant awards by keyword — award ID, recipient, amount, awarding agency. Source: USAspending.gov API (no key).

tools.name: imf_indicator
tools.description: Get IMF World Economic Outlook indicator for a country — GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, debt, etc. Source: IMF DataMapper API (free to use/redistribute with attribution, no key).

tools.name: edgar_fulltext_search
tools.description: Full-text search across ALL SEC EDGAR filings (EFTS) — find filings mentioning a keyword/phrase across companies. Extends the existing per-company SEC integration with cross-company filing search. Source: SEC EDGAR full-text search (public-domain, no key).

tools.name: nonprofit_990_lookup
tools.description: Get IRS Form 990 financial data for a US nonprofit by EIN — revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, officer compensation, contributions, and program revenue from the latest 990/990-EZ/990-PF filing, plus 5-year filing history. Source: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (public-domain IRS 990 XML).
